description: For text t and pattern p, reject |p|>64 with PatternTooLong{|p|}; otherwise output ordered M={i:0<=i<=|t|-|p| and t[i..i+|p|]=p}. Empty p yields all boundaries, including |t|.
state: Finite byte slices, exact ordered byte offsets or canonical cyclic index; tests observe assertions.
cost: O(256+m+n+k) time; 256 u64 masks and constant state, plus k returned usize offsets. No arbitrary text cap; allocator exhaustion is not a typed error.
forward: For text t and pattern p, reject |p|>64 with PatternTooLong{|p|}; otherwise output ordered M={i:0<=i<=|t|-|p| and t[i..i+|p|]=p}. Empty p yields all boundaries, including |t|.
inverse: For a fixed pattern and observed offsets, retain all texts whose matching-window positions are exactly those offsets, including texts of different lengths when compatible. An empty result for pattern b is compatible with aaa and ccc. Error length L retains all texts and every pattern of length L>64; byte contents are lost. No unique inverse or executable complete reconstructor is supplied.
checks: Independent bounded oracle, boundary fixtures, repeated debug/release, compiled negative controls; see model.md#tests
limitations: Finite evidence is not proof; partial syntax omits expansion and semantic resolution; allocation failure is not modeled.
